outcome.answer: Make user goals explicit rather than inferring them only from clicks or item transitions. Use comments and reviews to capture why someone chose an item, and model motivation and high-level intents to guide recommendations and make them more interpretable [1, 2, 4]. Distinguish a user’s current demand from the policy for what to recommend or avoid, then refine that policy using outcome feedback [10]. Natural-language profiles can also let users state and edit preferences directly, though systems need to be evaluated on whether they actually follow those instructions [9].
